lines.text: Put it down. Some of us are still counting.
Day zero. Nobody here owns your lease. Chalk a line for somebody who hasn't made it.
Day what? Chalk it. We all chalk it. Next round's on whoever's closest to ninety.
Grade five and still drinking with us. Most of them move up the street.
The Clause doesn't care who decanted you. It cares who's buying.

barks.text: Somebody's tally stopped at sixty-one. Nobody rubs it out.
Stray's no insult on the Row. Say it two streets over and see.
Looking for Vesper? Everybody is, first week. Last door on the street, past Spare Parts.
Day forty and I still check the lease. Nothing on it. I check.
Ninety days, the paper says. Nobody here has read the rest.
A Ferryman drank here last night. Paid up front and left before the round.
